(TIME SENSITIVE)? ? ? ? ? 3X MATCH ACTIVE: Help us defeat Big Oil this November >> https://links.messages.lcv.
Peter ? this is bad ? really bad. We've just received word that a major right-wing Super PAC has dropped $5 million into the Arizona Senate race, where Senator Mark Kelly is up against venture capital executive Blake Masters.

Mark Kelly is an environmental champion who just helped secure the most significant climate investment in history. Blake Masters is a climate change denier who's backed by white supremacists.

This move follows a poll that puts the race within two points. Masters' political backers see a window to swing this Senate race, and they've jumped on it. What's more: the same Super PAC has spent millions on the Senate race in Georgia for Herschel Walker to defeat Senator Raphael Warnock.

Peter: Bottom line, we need your help. Environmental field operations are still underfunded, and a group of donors has put together an emergency match fund to triple every contribution. We have to move now or we could lose these races.

Your support is needed to secure important wins from climate candidates in November. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT when you make a gift of any amount ? even $5 makes a difference >>> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_

We have a goal to knock on 161,875 doors in Arizona, and a total of 1.17 million doors in critical swing states including Nevada, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. And we have digital ads running in support of dozens of pro-environmental candidates, which we'll continue leading up to the election.

Study after study shows that speaking with voters through field organizing is the best way to connect with voters about where candidates stand on critical issues ? and get them to turn out on Election Day.

We're scaling up on-the-ground canvassing operations, getting folks to sign commit-to-vote cards, and helping them sign up to vote by mail. And we're encouraging voters to commit to reminding three friends or family members to vote, a tactic called "Vote Tripling."

We're looking for fellow environmentalists like you, Peter, to help us continue our canvassing efforts and get pro-climate candidates elected in November. Can you chip in?

Every single vote counts. Please, pitch in ? ANY amount can really make a difference right now, even if it's just $5. This could be the difference between ensuring an environmental majority or setting us back indefinitely >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-

Help defeat Blake Masters and the other Big Oil candidates running this election cycle. Our future depends on it.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith

LCV Victory Fund

We’ve arrived, friend.

The final stretch of this campaign season. There are just 25 days to go until Election Day when Michiganders head to the polls and absentee ballots start to be counted. It’s an exciting and important time, and I appreciate all the support you’ve provided to help our campaign reach this point. Now, before we start this final sprint toward the finish line (sorry, I had to drop in a running reference), I’m reaching out to make sure you’re updated on the information you need before Election Day.

We’ve already started driving voters where they need to be so they can vote early at their local clerk’s office or drop their completed ballot in the mail or at a secure drop box. I know you’re going to make your voice heard in this election. But the job of this campaign is to make sure that we turn out every possible member of our pro-democracy coalition to vote. And I’m as confident as ever that with your help, we’re going to make this happen.

Why do I think this campaign is in such a strong position to win on November 8th? Over the past several weeks, Michiganders from all walks of life, political leaders, and major news publications have joined to form a coalition of support for this campaign. From local publications such as the Detroit Free Press to Republican Congressman Adam Kinzinger, a non-partisan pro-democracy coalition is firmly behind my candidacy. The reason is clear: they know I will always put my oath as secretary of state above partisan politics.

On the campaign trail, I hear the same words of support from Michiganders across the ideological spectrum. They trust that I will faithfully carry out the sacred duty of election administration. And they know that I have a strong track record of protecting democracy in our state. When I say every voice must be heard and every vote must be counted, I mean it.

With the backing of such a diverse coalition of support, I’m confident that we’re going to be victorious on Election Day. But our work is not done yet. Over these next 25 days, this campaign is going to be working hard to get-out-the-vote to ensure my re-election. Will you support this effort today, friend?

Onward,
Jocelyn

subject: Jeopardy + 1/6 Digest

body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- It's been a long week, but I'm feeling energized after releasing our uniquely cross-partisan [Defenders of Democracy endorsement slate](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=2) on Tuesday and our January 6th Committee hearing on Thursday. If you missed the hearing (we've put together an excellent digest below), the biggest news to come out of it was our unanimous decision to subpoena former President Donald Trump to testify **UNDER OATH**. Now we all know President Trump is a pathological liar. But when he lies at a rally, or on Fox News, or on social media, he's not really putting himself in any legal jeopardy. That's quite different when you lie under oath. So as pundits and politicians speculate as to whether he'll actually testify, let's explore what _could_ happen:
1. Trump could testify and tell the truth.
2. Trump could testify and be caught in a lie.
3. Trump could testify and Plead the Fifth.
4. Trump could refuse to testify, in which case Congress could vote to hold him in contempt and refer the matter to the DOJ.

At the end of the day, we don't have any control over which course Donald Trump will take. But whatever he does _will_ further cement his legacy in our history books. This movement is making history, too, as we continue uniting the **Reasonable Majority** from all parties and of none to band together to defend democracy, stand for truth, solve problems, and mend divisions. This is the only path I see to our nation closing this dark, dangerous chapter and making room for the **American Dream Reborn**. The greatest help you could give is to spread the word about [Country First](https://www.country1st.com/opportunity?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=3) to _at least two_ of your likeminded family and friends; and if you're in a position to do so, continue supporting our critical mission with a [donation](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=4) or through our [shop](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=5) **(by popular request we just added NEW yard signs and women's athleisure).** It's an honor to have you alongside me. Thank you for believing our democracy is worth it. Country First, Adam
* * *
* * *
* * *
|
## 1/6 Committee Digest
Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. **In Case You Missed It:**
* Rep. Kinzinger appears on MSNBC's 'Morning Joe' to [preview](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRbYMFEDt3gf_PoP7QRl-c_y&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=6) the Thursday hearing and announce Country First’s Defenders of Democracy endorsements.
* Rep. Kinzinger [appears](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHk1KOxbf7BAxkl_YXQz_ury-evQadUzE5TIRlNo26a73-sBymeIxr3Am1oJTv4jUTLsuQY7bgGME-whiCqg0TpNNrodC2XyBPfvi8aBf5-Lr2ciRGm_7-UvlyWbYKLI5X5mgo7s71xiNAs1U1qYXPbg&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=7) on CNN 'Tonight with Jake Tapper,' speaking about the groundbreaking decision to subpoena former President Trump.

* * *
Here are the major developments from the committee: **1/6 Committee Votes Unanimously to Subpoena Former President Trump** In a surprising turn of events on Thursday, the 1/6 Committee voted to subpoena former President Trump to testify under oath before the committee. In the expected final hearing, a bipartisan group of lawmakers came together in an effort to gather more evidence surrounding the vicious attack on the US Capitol. The subpoena has not been formally issued, but [sources](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDYQmyt3fftOoEcuxYqeCeVL_-Ak4BAbXGHSuEuIq9dS9wa0ovt_DAh6wlUZLG3SmiX-ex1VP1V_sq0PyIeGWnNxbrTE5NP41x9Pd1pEBsSJQw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=8) indicate the official subpoena will be delivered within days. The resolution was introduced by Vice Chairwoman Liz Cheney (R-WY) and passed unanimously after the first break of the hearing. This marks the first time that the 1/6 Committee has voted to issue a subpoena during a public hearing. The former President [reacted](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=OwehQGnYjrzpIc0rxaR28aVqWR_hO_uF0RFcZ1gk2B-uqejYhM35b0tU_hwvgEjcKyz2GZeESajEKv6dR1_6_pWgld5uDgoDEldf2P9QbCyID9cZWnIOmETvUAFNw-lR5dqDEIGN3d-zoadIg9pEjoSLWV2zI9yWROgeXFLEH2UKijSROxEL23YDPbzKp1DeeaMNiIvVWMy3N7AnLUivb3kUDqxWat_dzws8EEZo-vc&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=9) to the subpoena, questioning why the committee waited so long. It is unclear whether the former President will comply with the subpoena. **New Evidence Shows Secret Service was Aware of Threats of Violence Prior to Attack** In past hearings, members of the public were told the Secret Service was aware of threats made the morning of the attack. New evidence presented by the 1/6 Committee on Thursday corroborated prior hearings, proving that the Secret Service was [aware](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=qyDi432GwqzcezEbr9kAv0PGqO6DBt1AnoK2JqKn-miVTYNzK8j_WZIBXtu-8eVs4ig1XmxHhml8hUKIyVqQIb5MjuRc0vguQIM8h2paXbyp2QVBH62DqFMHMYJip6GF1OZAoZlw53a-c7nXjLzzVJ_0mKzREcXb5cCEE77HL9s&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=10) of the potential and probability of violence on January 6, 2021, but did not act to increase security that day. In newly revealed text messages, the agents knew there were weapons, including firearms, in the crowd on January 6th. In an email from December 26, 2020, Secret Service members were alerted to a threat made by a far-right group known as the Proud Boys. The email included knowledge of a probable threat of violence large enough to overwhelm the US Capitol Police. One agent described the day before the attack as, "Calm before the storm I assume." As reported earlier, texts sent from Secret Service agents were deleted. The 1/6 Committee is still working to recover those messages. Not only was the Secret Service privy to activity in the days leading up to January 6th, they had knowledge about ballistics helmets, weapons, and other gear in the crowd on the 6th. Further, Trump requested that they remove the metal detectors during the event so that those who were armed could be let into the rally. Many of the people who came to the rally on January 6th were ready for violence. The Secret Service knew all of this, and Trump did, too. **Pelosi, Schumer, Shown Pleading with Police, Governors, and Other Leaders to Help Subdue the Insurrection** One of the most asked questions was answered by the 1/6 Committee yesterday: Speaker Pelosi DID, in fact, try to [fortify](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=FECXgvVBAH18GBWRCy8D9bmQjRYvg5RiftfZZQBIKJ-0J2h82Sq9jN2gH80hNGOLuX3SkiR2sS2XDuzziBTGBMfKW_ybYjwcbh1f1_3GItH69PY-wxPXH59mFYoB8YlWPiOEwS3jc4GoN8aHy0aZeUSNpIGRJwESp7P5VTVf_0RqrfKIs6A9siOEREGYyxKf&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=11) the US Capitol on the day of the attack. Video shot by Pelosi’s daughter shows Pelosi, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and other top democrats attempting to regain control of the Capitol. In the newly released footage, Speaker Pelosi is seen calling governors, the acting Attorney General, the acting Secretary of Defense, and other top government officials pleading with them to deploy law enforcement and military personnel to the Capitol. While other members of Congress, like Senator Josh Hawley (R-MO), can be seen running to a secure location to flee the violent mob he earlier egged on, Speaker Pelosi, Majority Leader Schumer, and others can be seen calmly but urgently asking for assistance. Committee member Jamie Raskin [commented](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=zveC7zroragI2qrXZZ9Nau8g06OiiFSrYZB4vdSsTxyR1XxV8tT0F1cfb4uy6F4mvvGDrainX7jT8huHxUMo9aMSpRKI-lisAn5_6xT8XEz3xWgfaSmUpAD3liM7uAC2jF3QdszxOAwanpEHUVmh_s3D0fmSVuNUDw2EC3z8xCOam_PUgBwGUB59g40MIifQ&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=12) on the footage: "As the president watched the bloody attack unfold on Fox News from his dining room, members of Congress and other government officials stepped into the gigantic leadership void created by the president’s chilling and steady passivity that day." Then, later that evening, the footage shows the relief congressional leaders felt as they received the news that they would be able to continue to count the electoral votes that night. **Trump and Allies Planned to Declare Victory Before Election** A memo obtained from the National Archives and a video deposition [confirm](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GUadKUZbNtXpoQtrN7XiLlDAp0T1nvsEvUIUmB084zGT08gjjQ1xOMnHochqfYSr4UhXeRZZ7Ks4cEQAh-gRPvDqcABnlLUjPSUVI5Mv49WKw1GY0G--ot2UHbZuCbzUvneegwY21Irl1vdFgvHiGw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=13) the former President's plan to declare victory before voting even started. For weeks before voting started, Trump’s closest allies like Steve Bannon, Roger Stone, and Tom Fitton had "advanced knowledge" of Trump’s decision to declare victory. "What Trump is going to do is declare victory..., but that doesn’t mean he is the winner. He’s just going to say he is the winner," Bannon said in October. In a video interview with Trump campaign advisor Brad Parscale, we learned the former President [planned](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=T2MdJJ0AOpyFQaFe8tFv36U2o4Yt1uRWbBNMobzkc9eQNO_UY0hbnz9wqbrNN1KTfniuyOl-Xst9bjuFjzUOUdnq0a7j34pQHtc6ub-7YyYLCaxV6YvbB-BAWfDYAZ3b&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=14) to declare victory regardless of the outcome as early as July. In fact, the 1/6 Committee presented evidence showing Trump and Tom Fitton, the president of Judicial Watch, worked on a speech to be given on election night declaring victory. The former President intended to stay in power no matter the outcome. **Former Transportation Secretary Says January 6th was "Shocking"** As a myriad of Trump cabinet officials and other top aides resigned after January 6th, one of the most notable was Transportation Secretary Elaine Chao, who is married to Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell. Chao [met](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHlxOww_eP95bxQBYEjn713xbIKaPhbytj_DELvvfmXnHBnCvbqD3hMONhILIzdBsqU76za-dG68_eujupvEv0qCB6C_CA5dM3Vjbbw6d9yE5&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=15) with the 1/6 Committee to speak about her decision to leave the Trump Administration following the attack. She called the attack on the Capitol "shocking," adding that the attempted coup was "not something [she] could put aside." "And at a particular point, the events were such that it was impossible for me to continue, given my personal values and my philosophy. I came as an immigrant to this country. I believe in this country. I believe in the peaceful transfer of power. I believe in democracy. And so I was — it was a decision that I made on my own," she said. **Trump’s Allies Were In Contact, Amplifying Violence by Trump Base Prior to January 6, Committee Reveals** The 1/6 Committee [revealed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=EgoLP66qKbjSe1ZxerGwBNOa6yty5CoLuxhyswU6lAyGRkwpQQhEfYW9om3_yoExJ6725UORwnhQlHtH6ELCWxe-mWqGrUCNRoSa2euH4BKCYHtvnqt0e50mWBr9knKuP3ewfJ3ROIpsqefmKQClJhSOsJfYT9CRS5xE443X9aSncFWdirXQTSVf772JgeeDDoHAhc65ISLG7XMHtO-bPV_nd-V5X-s5LOkhm7Vz9wtjGVNQeDhWdTPpeKiG_tLsucsV_7Yao0qp_Q6-pIVLKLIPFSepY7mq04sDiSZ-Ui4TeTSU4IoQRCa8AnMsSDzgCW86V6vmIn9SXI_nOW96-IxciHGLQ9XOJhWuL8gCFf4RV5tTbMETePKIquBXm11Cd5NATavhzfUbwQTgmR4ayalAIHnWVKeOfHiKHoDcoUY&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=16) previously unseen communications between Trump allies and top aides prior to the attack. Former President Trump's communications advisor, Jason Miller, touted his ability to rally the Trump base, texting then Chief of Staff Mark Meadows, "I got the base FIRED UP," taking credit for amplifying the violent messages posted on a pro-Trump website, TheDonald.Win. On the website, calls for violence streamed in, calling for "patriots" to gather with weapons and seemingly threaten members of Congress to keep Trump in power. One message said, "Our 'lawmakers' in Congress can leave one of two ways: 1) in a body bag 2) after rightfully certifying Trump the winner." The website was shared by Mr. Miller, indicating he was aware of the violent themes circulating in the days leading to January 6th. **Trump Knew He lost Despite Claiming Victory ** While former President Trump was publicly claiming victory, and raising money to fight "election fraud," he was privately complaining of his loss and making decisions knowing he had lost. In an interview with General Mark Milley, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Milley recalled a time when the former President said something to the effect of, "we lost, we need to let that issue go to the next guy." Communications Director Alyssa Farah Griffin corroborated Milley, recalling an interaction in the Oval Office after the election. According to Farah Griffin, Trump said, "Can you believe I lost to this f***ing guy?" Trump’s [order](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GjwzQmjoNJNKZ7-eUAZR_IHCWVZ2MFKcbC-8XoZf2I6uc_jto2EjarLQ1eEAL7xB9fIP7K2Dd2zLLy4_3W2mWwkWU7gxfwHUA2tPi6llHXLcX3JJhRXYwPM_ioFq2Eb7nVNwBj5ywjj8R5rUet-Dnw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=j6_committe_digest_nd&n=17) to rapidly withdraw US troops from Afghanistan and Somalia shortly after the 2020 election came under fire from Rep. Adam Kinzinger on Thursday: "He disregarded concerns about the consequences for fragile governments on the front lines of the fight against [the Islamic State] and al-Qaeda terrorists," Kinzinger said. "Knowing he was leaving office, he acted immediately and signed this order on November 11th, which would have required the immediate withdrawal of troops from Somalia and Afghanistan, all to be complete before the Biden inauguration on January 20th." General Milley called the order "potentially dangerous" and did not think it was possible. Lt. General Keith Kellogg called the order a "tremendous disservice to [the] nation."

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z670bf5sa11vqjcnjdo9e4lus4rvc6thd74p9cmg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uhhr9c9ksor64p35cqpbatb2e8pj6tlnm5h31crje6obattmciqedc9ke5qe8ptnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6iqr9o3mchj3appl6hjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or3clie8ob1c3ge49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5516u8m1hn6s75mh8pcdrrg1ir8u709j9m06tdg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbv8066hib5clt1m3jk6se91o5drqrsuksnonplg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s3h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdqs094hse3kdotdlg4jjpqkm3sb7sa2ckncvm60_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s3h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I just read the urgent letter signed by 34 innocent Americans, jailed in Washington, D.C for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 presidential election.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy through a 4-inch by 10-inch window of cold metal doors
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without a shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

Outrageously, there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water and keep them from attending court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for up to a year and a half...in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban, al-Qaeda, and ISIS terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m Larry Klayman, the founder ofstrong Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows. I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you’ve given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you’ve ever given to Freedom Watch.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbont7315mkrov354e91pde72jv5fk0bjrp0vp20_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s1h2bs)

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, I’m heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1d26p9mpnr6rj61hltmtvk9u4bbvmbp0p1rv2qo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s1h2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping innocent Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers and clergy!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

And another protester, a patriot grandma with cancer, just finished serving 60 days in federal prison for a crime she didn’t commit.

[But there’s something you can do about it ...you can donate immediately to Freedom Watch’s critically important lawsuit to HELP FREE the rest of these persecuted patriots with your crucial gift today.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zo0g5bonn3bcjc6fv6hlieiek48hmoa7vsujsfeo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cji62ob0s1h2bs)

I just read the urgent letter signed by 34 innocent Americans, jailed in Washington, D.C for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 presidential election.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy through a 4-inch by 10-inch window of cold metal doors
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without a shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

Outrageously, there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water and keep them from attending court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for up to a year and a half...in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban, al-Qaeda, and ISIS terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m Larry Klayman, the founder ofstrong Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows. I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you’ve given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you’ve ever given to Freedom Watch.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z426m3dljlgudjk9avcasi3im6p6g2mi3ga5008g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjh68or4cjh2bs)

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, I’m heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z9ljnsp336k5uqitct4pn0e6apetqp7eud2m9bc8_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjh68or4cjh2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping innocent Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers and clergy!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

And another protester, a patriot grandma with cancer, just finished serving 60 days in federal prison for a crime she didn’t commit.

[But there’s something you can do about it ...you can donate immediately to Freedom Watch’s critically important lawsuit to HELP FREE the rest of these persecuted patriots with your crucial gift today.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8rka7d7hl2f1g6vl8hgjanch2sua9tbgbikfoo0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjh68or4cjh2bs)

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?"
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zovmrajo05em1kmm4itjvbeng3rai2f3oq0p0fg8_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjj64ob6c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfddtlc2qm0o73c5i3aohncoor5cjhe5g6ddr3mjgbbcjks9or9o5gmlg7aphncsrt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9qmcclimdgmfchjcor61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrn2ri4og214mkfjht5c039rgsq1d6ird5a8lfag_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjj64ob6c3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoeiq0241gpd8tpo8si9pdvn65hdqg7p2ue1vvv8_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjj64ob6c3h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5bv9q31c4vfgt8s81cjk411d0kj2d1nef45ui7g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cjj64ob6c3h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Chrissy
subject: It’s been a whirlwind, but there’s much to celebrate!
body:
A NOTE FROM CHRISSY

The election is less than a month away – 22 days, but who is counting – and the sprint to it is a whirlwind. My team and I have ramped up our campaign to reach every voter across PA-06 and ensure they head to the polls, fully informed on our race, by Election Day. During all of this, my favorite part of the campaign has been bringing you news of the progress we’ve made together. In that spirit, I am excited to share some progress worth celebrating:

Recipient of two distinctive Democracy Awards for serving our community
Perhaps Bradford Fitch, president and CEO of the Congressional Management Foundation, says it best – “Americans usually only hear about Congress when something goes wrong. The Democracy Awards shines a light on Congress when it does something right.” I am exceedingly humbled to have recently been awarded two of these distinguished awards, one for Constituent Services and the other for Workplace Environment – making me the first member ever to win two awards in the same term. Not only do these awards honor the acts of fostering innovation and transparency in Congress, but more importantly, they highlight my commitment to serving the PA-06 community. This is at the core of everything I do. That’s why my team and I work hard to build relationships with colleagues from across the political spectrum, as we listen to deliver for our community. I look forward to continuing to build on the progress we’ve made for our district.

Ensuring access to high-quality, affordable health care and education
These past few years have proven just how important providing high-quality care to patients truly is. That’s why I am excited to share our office's proposal to help fund Alvernia University's nursing program and support its partnership with Reading Area Community College. This crucial investment will not only support Berks County jobs and the health of our community, it will also make resources affordable and accessible to all Pennsylvanians pursuing a career in allied health.

Supporting and celebrating women in the Air Force
Growing up, my role model was the astronaut Sally Ride. Seeing her fly to space, I knew I wanted to be just like her, so I secured an ROTC scholarship to study engineering, then joined the Air Force. But as a Captain in the Air Force and a leader in the private sector, I saw only a few people who looked like me. Today, women make up more than 20% of active-duty enlisted personnel in the Air Force. I can confidently say that our military is stronger because of the number of women in our ranks, including Ms. Gina Ortiz Jones, the under secretary of the Air Force, who has spent her career working to protect U.S. economic and national security. I encourage women and girls from every background to consider a career in the Air Force. We need your grit, determination, and strength to make this country and world a more secure place for future generations. I hope in the coming years, I’ll be able to say women make up 50% of our DoD.

Ramping up for the election
And with so much on the line – from voting rights to reproductive freedom – this year's midterm elections are a pivotal chance for us to fight back. With less than a month until Election Day, we are lacing up and knocking on neighbors’ doors all across PA-06. To continue to fight for our democracy and the right to choose, and lower costs and better jobs, I need you out there with me! I hope you get a chance to join me. You can sign up here to volunteer.

"I’m extremely grateful for the community we have built here, and I look forward to sharing more good news in the future. In the meantime, I hope you get a chance to look at our volunteering website for exciting events and opportunities to join our team!

Thank you as always. There is work to be done."

– Chrissy

All of the work we've been putting in for months will come down to the next four weeks. We are committed to doing everything we can to help Chrissy win in PA-06, but we can't do this without the support of our grassroots team. Your support is what powers our work and allows us to continue making history electing leaders like Chrissy – including on November 8.

Will you make a donation to help reelect Chrissy to Congress? Your support means Chrissy can continue to pass bold, meaningful legislation in Congress that will truly help working folks and their families across PA-06.

Thank you for your support.

-Team Chrissy

**We’re getting really nervous about this year’s election.** It’s only 22 days away, and GOP lawmakers are working harder than ever to create barriers to the polls for Black voters.

This isn’t new. It’s part of the GOP’s decades-long, racist plan to suppress and intimidate Black voters. **_And right now, it’s working for them._**

subject: We won’t "get over it" but we won’t give up either

body:
It’s Mandy and Kathryn, and we’re here to give you a reason to be hopeful as we head into the final weeks of New Hampshire’s critical battle ground race for U.S. Senate.
| | |
---
Hi there, friend! It’s Mandy and Kathryn, and we’re here to give you a reason to be hopeful as we head into the final weeks of New Hampshire’s critical battleground race for U.S. Senate.
**It’s you!**
Just by reading this email – **[and of course by giving $3, or whatever you can](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52712577/373153806/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1828-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODFmYzgwMS01ZjRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WxoVOheHvVVgFVFY7XnC77HJsd_-NXz-Uy03fjvj1vI=)** – you are helping to support Maggie Hassan’s campaign.
It is truly inspiring to see droves of our fellow citizens speaking out, getting involved, and giving to candidates that they believe in. And beyond just being inspirational to folks like us, who have been engaging in this work for a long time, it has a genuine impact on our country.
**[And your voice (and your gift) has never been more important, because Maggie is facing a tough race against a radical right-wing opponent.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52712588/373153809/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1828-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODFmYzgwMS01ZjRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WxoVOheHvVVgFVFY7XnC77HJsd_-NXz-Uy03fjvj1vI=)**
When Maggie’s opponent, Don Bolduc, was asked about the threat of a nationwide abortion ban, do you know what his response was? **Telling women to “get over it.”**
Well, you know what, folks, we won’t “**get over it**.” We refuse to let Don Bolduc sweep his dangerous, radical, anti-choice agenda under the rug, but we also refuse to give in to despair.
Yes, the prospect of Don Bolduc as a U.S. Senator is terrifying, but the truth is we are more hopeful than ever. That’s thanks, in no small part, to the outpouring of support from people like you, for champions like Maggie Hassan.
We’ve followed Maggie and have always admired her ferocious work on the behalf of women and all Americans. And now she needs people like us, everyone, to help her defeat Don Bolduc and continue that important work.
**[Giving a gift of even just $3 or $10 has a real impact in a race as close as Maggie’s, so if you have been looking for a way to get involved, this is it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52712592/373153816/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1828-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODFmYzgwMS01ZjRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WxoVOheHvVVgFVFY7XnC77HJsd_-NXz-Uy03fjvj1vI=)**
You don’t have to “get over it” – in fact, you shouldn’t, but you don’t have to give in either. **You can act!**
So please, join us in turning rage into hope.
Your voice matters,
– Mandy Patinkin & Kathryn Grody
| | _Kathryn Grody and Mandy Patinkin are actors and activists who have been married for almost 42 years. Patinkin is most known for his roles in_ Homeland _and_ The Princess Bride _. Grody wrote and acted in an autobiographical play called_ Mom's Life _. During the 2020 election, Grody and Patinkin gathered a large social media following for their viral videos encouraging people to vote._

Nikki has spent her life fighting for workers and working families by strengthening unions nationwide, and she was instrumental in passing a $15 minimum wage in Illinois while working as a senior advisor for Governor JB Pritzker. So today, I’m reaching out about one of the most important races this cycle: **We have the incredible opportunity to unseat one of the worst Republicans in the US House, Rep. Chabot, and replace him with a champion for families.**

Our slim House majority is on the line in just a few weeks, and I know Greg Landsman is the leader we need to retire Chabot and protect our democracy, fundamental rights, and so much more.

**[Will you join me in supporting Greg Landsman’s people-powered campaign for this Ohio toss-up seat by chipping in $3 today? We need all hands on deck to get this done »](https://default.salsalabs.org/T25ce0c37-18b9-4c36-8eaf-93fb38ce2966/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey Abrams again and I want to tell you a story.

But first, tomorrow I will step on stage to finally confront Brian Kemp on
his dangerous agenda for Georgians. That’s why my team made a goal to
raise $500,000 before our rematch Monday night.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221016_B1_Valedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=13219%2E1862389%2EUEXMyy ]So Derek, will you invest $25 — or even
$5 — right now into this campaign? Every cent of your
contribution will fuel our efforts to reach voters and get out the Early
Vote — which begins tomorrow.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221016_B1_Valedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13219%2E1862389%2EUEXMyy ]DONATE

In 1991, I graduated as the valedictorian of Avondale High School. Like
most Georgia valedictorians, I was invited to meet the Governor of Georgia
at the Governor’s Mansion.

It was a big deal for my family. That morning, I got up and put on my
Sunday best. My parents and I boarded the MARTA bus with the other riders
who could not afford a car.

We took MARTA all the way from DeKalb County to Buckhead, got off at West
Paces Ferry Road, and walked up the long driveway to the big black gates
around the property. When we got to the guard station, the guard looked at
my parents, then he looked at me and said, “This is a private event, you
don’t belong here.”

He looked over our shoulder at the MARTA bus driving away and he told
himself a story about who would be on that bus — and in his story, they
did not belong in the Governor’s Mansion.

My parents pushed back and I got in. But looking back on that day, I don’t
remember meeting the Governor of Georgia. I don’t even remember
celebrating my accomplishments with valedictorians from 159 counties and
180 school districts. The only thing I remember is a man blocking the
gates of the most powerful place in Georgia, telling me that I did not
belong.

For years, I have spent my life in public service opening the gates of
opportunity for those often left behind. And I am not going to quit
now, Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221016_B1_Valedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=13219%2E1862389%2EUEXMyy ]In these final hours before I step on the debate stage, I’m humbly
asking that you put aside any misgivings you may have about politics right
now and help me make a real difference in the lives of millions of
Georgians. If you are able, can you chip in $5 to help me
get my message out to voters in every corner of Georgia? Every cent and
every second is critical in these final days, and we must reach our Debate
Night Fund goal before tomorrow’s deadline.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221016_B1_Valedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=13219%2E1862389%2EUEXMyy ]DONATE

Let’s open those gates for good,
Derek.

— Stacey Abrams

body:
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=1001&akid=1078%2E61531%2EhZHC7t ]Welch for Vermont

There’s just 23 days left until Election Day, and we’ve been hard at work ensuring
Peter’s elected as Vermont’s next senator these past few weeks—come see
what’s been happening on the campaign trail:

A couple Fridays ago, Sen. Amy Klobuchar joined Peter and the Vermont
Democratic Party for a reproductive freedom roundtable, where they
discussed the current state of reproductive rights in Vermont and around
the country, Vermont’s Reproductive Liberty Amendment (Article 22 on
November’s ballot), and what Congress can do to protect reproductive
freedom for every American regardless of their zip code.

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: what you talk about at dinner
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.
| | |
---
Peter, as a kid, no matter how busy my mom and dad were, we always sat down as a family to eat dinner together.
When I became a mother myself, I carried on this same tradition with my own family, and there was always an open seat and a full plate for anyone who wanted to join us.
While the food was usually delicious (especially once my son Matt started doing the cooking), the best part of dinner was always the conversation. **We came together as a family around the kitchen table to celebrate wins, talk through problems, and identify solutions – from the highs and lows of high school to the issues facing our country.** It was a time to pray together, reflect together, grieve together, laugh together, find connection, and dream big as a team.
**I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.** If you want to solve the problems that a community, state, or country faces, you should start by pulling up a chair and listening to the conversations families have over dinner.
Although I wish I could invite every single person on this team over to my own kitchen table, unfortunately, with the election just around the corner, that's not feasible. **[So instead, I'm inviting you to participate in my Dinner Table Priorities survey. Please, can you take just a moment to complete my survey before 11:59 p.m. tonight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52741275/373215548/1334226984?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk332-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWU4NDNkMC04ZDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QrtoU8_CxEQCElBfNUlKRnOSPvhmsaLAaE-P8pyJYBQ=&emci=afae53b5-354b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=91e843d0-8d4d-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=4450063)**

For me, leadership has always been about listening. That's how I led my family as a mother, that's how I best advocated for my patients as a nurse, and it's how I will lead Missouri as your next senator. I will always put families before politics, and I will be nobody's senator but yours.
That's why input from grassroots supporters has always been so central to this campaign. **And now, as we head into the final days of this election, I need to hear from you again – to hear what problems your family faces, what worries keep you up at night, and what you're most hopeful for. **
Your answers to this survey will be incredibly helpful in informing our campaign strategy for our Get Out The Vote efforts. **I'm reviewing responses first thing tomorrow morning, so I need to hear from you ASAP.[Please, will you make your voice heard tonight? With the election so close, hearing from grassroots supporters like you is incredibly important to our campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52741277/373215555/1334226984?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk332-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWU4NDNkMC04ZDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QrtoU8_CxEQCElBfNUlKRnOSPvhmsaLAaE-P8pyJYBQ=&emci=afae53b5-354b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=91e843d0-8d4d-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=4450063)**

subject: Hoping to connect with Peter
body:
Hey there, Peter. I hope you're enjoying the weekend.

**Election Day is just 22 days away.**

This weekend, Team Sorensen staff and volunteers are working extremely hard -- going door to door making sure our supporters have all the information they need to submit their votes.

Speaking directly to voters has been the best tool in our arsenal to gauge how voters are feeling headed into November. subject: A Message from a Veteran
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Donna Korn for Broward County School Board, Seat 8
body:
www.donnakorn.com [www.donnakorn.com]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/102049/images/Untitled%20design.png]
Dear Friend,

My name is Donald Pilger, and I am reaching out to you today to ask you to support my daughter, Donna Korn, for Broward Countywide School Board Seat 8.

Service runs deep in our family. My brothers and I all served in the Army and Air Force and spent years fighting for our country in Vietnam and abroad. Many of us continued to serve you as Firefighters here in South Florida where my wife, a schoolteacher, and I, raised Donna and her three siblings. We taught our children the meaning of service to this country and community from sheltering children as a foster family to donating time in soup kitchens.

That’s why I am so proud that Donna has followed in our footsteps.

Following her graduation from Emory University, Donna came to serve the community as a teacher at her alma-mater Western High School. Her commitment to our community far exceeded the classroom. Whether as Guardian ad-Litem serving as a voice for children that are voiceless, a PTA President, or a board member on many boards such as the Children's Services Council, the Children’s Services Board, H.A.N.D.Y., the Early Learning Coalition, Voices for Children or as an ambassador for the United Way of Broward, Donna, has dedicated her life to children and Broward County.

I am especially proud that one of Donna’s personal missions is a commitment to ensuring our next generation Honors and Respects our active Military and Veterans who have given all to our country.

Donna is an ardent supporter of Broward’s JROTC program which is the largest in the country. She has worked tirelessly to foster the program’s success in our schools leading to an almost perfect graduation rate of 99% among our amazing cadets. She has spearheaded initiatives such as collaborating with Broward County's JROTC annually for a special Veteran's Day recognition effort as well as raising awareness to the suicide risk for our Veterans, by personally participating and involving JROTC cadets, student athletes and community members in the 22 a Day Push Up Challenge. She also makes a personal effort to support Veterans and has served as a Guardian to one of our honored Korean Veterans on an Honor Flight Mission.

I know how devoted my daughter is to this community and to paying tribute to and ensuring our children Honor, Recognize and Respect our Military and First Responders.

Please vote for Donna so we can continue our family tradition of serving the wonderful people of Broward County.

From a Loving Father,

Donald Pilger

Over the long course of our shared history, the United States has lived through a number of monumental crises.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to face up to — and live up to — the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
I've spent more than four decades making films about turning points in American history in an attempt to help us understand our past and interpret our present. I know when a historic moment is upon us, and the outcome of the November election is clearly such a moment.
Now more than ever, it’s important to support leaders who unite us in defending our democracy — no matter your party affiliation. And Arizona Senator Mark Kelly has proved himself to be such a leader, a good man who has spent his life serving our country, and who will continue to honorably serve not only Arizonans but all Americans.
Plainly said, the United States Senate needs Mark Kelly. We need Mark Kelly. So, please:

subject: My Opponent Caught on Camera [Must See Video]
body:
Dear Peter,
I had to see it to believe it myself.
My opponent, far-left Democrat Marie Perez, has been trying to fool voters in our district into thinking she's a "moderate."
But she was recently caught on camera endorsing Biden and Pelosi's so-called "Inflation Reduction Act," and said she'd vote for it if she was in Congress.
Watch the video her campaign does not want you to see here: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Inflation](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Lh4nyqhYP7epZm892wvYqkXA/GmusbskYbzyFrcjrwpl1Iw).
The non-partisan Congressional Budget Office has confirmed what we knew all along about this bill, that it:
* Makes inflation **even worse - while we are currently experiencing the worst inflation in 40 years. **
* Raises taxes on domestic energy production in the midst of record high gas prices.
* Hires 87,000 new IRS employees to target middle-class earners.
* Subsidizes jobs... in China.

Help me expose Marie Perez and share the video she doesn't want voters to see. Make an emergency donation to my campaign at https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate.
When I'm elected, I will slam the breaks on the Biden-Pelosi agenda and put fighting inflation, energy independence, and serious congressional oversight at the top of the agenda.
**But I can 't do that if I don't win, and if I don't win, it's unlikely that Republicans will take back the House. **
Can this country afford another two years of Democrat control?
Absolutely not. Please help me win my race by contributing at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/8V6f7Us41p9e8I3t3ZaZ763w/GmusbskYbzyFrcjrwpl1Iw).
Thank You,

Joe Kent

I have 15 minutes of free time this morning, friend. It may not sound like much – but I've been working long hours in Congress to pass President Biden's agenda, and a gap in my schedule like this is rare.
So, as I'm sitting with my husband, Jerry, and drinking my coffee, I'm reflecting on this historic campaign. I've decided I need to tell you a little bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate – _**[but if you're ready to help me flip this seat now, you can click here to donate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52722802/373186621/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4873-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDM0ZjhkZC03MTRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MybGxpS88H1UElKqmC-H72T3uizQGcvpAxhoJ1BSnkI=)**_
Back when I was growing up in Jacksonville, I went to segregated schools, washed dishes and worked at McDonald's. But my mom saw something special in me. She'd tell me I was _destined_ for something bigger.
So, when I thought about 2022 and what our country needed to build back better after a disastrous presidency, I thought about her everlasting words to me: "Never tire, Val." I thought about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader who understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I thought about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy. And, in the background of all of this, I heard my mother's voice in my head telling me I could win.
So, I decided to run. And now, I'm just 1 point behind Marco Rubio in a race that can decide Senate control, and the stakes are higher than ever: We have a 50-50 split in the Senate. If we lose just one seat, Mitch McConnell regains Senate control – and two Democratic seats are now rated as toss-ups.

It's critical that we win in Florida – and this race is tight right now, friend. I'm proud that our movement has an average donation of just $28.45, but building a people-powered movement means it's going to take all hands on deck to compete against the GOP's millions in dark money already pouring into Florida.
My 15 minutes are almost up, and I have to run to my next call: I hate to ask this, but if you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $5 today? All the best,

Val Demings

body:
|
#
---
Good morning, Peter— This is a longer email than usual, but it’s important, and I hope you have the time to read it all the way through. I’d like to talk about an issue that is very important to all Oregonians — the humanitarian crisis in our own backyards. The homelessness crisis is a complex problem that needs to be addressed with people-centered solutions that can help people achieve stability and permanent housing. **I am the only candidate with the experience and plan to tackle the housing and homelessness crisis.** I championed legislation that increased housing access, shelter capacity, rent assistance, and other housing needs. At the beginning of 2020, I called for a statewide emergency declaration on the homelessness crisis and developed a homelessness relief package that we were ready to pass in the 2020 legislative session. Unfortunately, one of my opponents, Republican Christine Drazan, led her colleagues to **walk off the job and flee the state, which ultimately killed every bill we were working on – including that homelessness relief package.** Ironically, Christine is _now calling for the very same emergency declaration_ in an attempt to rewrite her failed record on homelessness. Thankfully, we didn’t give up on the people of Oregon or let Rep. Drazan’s obstructionism get in the way. We were able to successfully pass many of these proposals within a year. But we lost momentum nonetheless. There’s clearly much more we have to do. As Governor, I will start tackling the crisis in the following three ways:
* Within my first 30 days in office, I’ll form a special emergency management team with one mission: end unsheltered homelessness for veterans, families with children, unaccompanied youth, and seniors by 2025.

* I’ll immediately prioritize expanding managed shelters, improving access to mental health and addiction services, and getting new street outreach teams on the ground to help people get off the streets, tent by tent.

* On Day One, I will issue an executive order to increase the pace and scale of housing production statewide, with a focus on financing housing that’s affordable for middle class families.

**Oregonians deserve a governor who will roll up her sleeves, sweat the details, and find real solutions to Oregon’s biggest problems. I am the only candidate in this race who will always put people over politics.** **[So please, I am personally asking you to contribute whatever you can to help grow our grassroots campaign and build a better future for Oregon together.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52743414/373226166/1970451000?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221016_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOGE2OTJlMC05ZDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QY4Hq3WHi5UHzAvghXjxZW1ELYQCPlktukO4yYJ7Zro=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52743416/373226173/1970451000?express_lane=true&amount=10&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221016_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOGE2OTJlMC05ZDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QY4Hq3WHi5UHzAvghXjxZW1ELYQCPlktukO4yYJ7Zro=)

clean_body: | Good morning, Peter— This is a longer email than usual, but it’s important, and I hope you have the time to read it all the way through. I’d like to talk about an issue that is very important to all Oregonians — the humanitarian crisis in our own backyards. The homelessness crisis is a complex problem that needs to be addressed with people-centered solutions that can help people achieve stability and permanent housing. I am the only candidate with the experience and plan to tackle the housing and homelessness crisis. I championed legislation that increased housing access, shelter capacity, rent assistance, and other housing needs. At the beginning of 2020, I called for a statewide emergency declaration on the homelessness crisis and developed a homelessness relief package that we were ready to pass in the 2020 legislative session. Unfortunately, one of my opponents, Republican Christine Drazan, led her colleagues to walk off the job and flee the state, which ultimately killed every bill we were working on – including that homelessness relief package. Ironically, Christine is now calling for the very same emergency declaration in an attempt to rewrite her failed record on homelessness. Thankfully, we didn’t give up on the people of Oregon or let Rep. Drazan’s obstructionism get in the way. We were able to successfully pass many of these proposals within a year. But we lost momentum nonetheless. There’s clearly much more we have to do. As Governor, I will start tackling the crisis in the following three ways: Within my first 30 days in office, I’ll form a special emergency management team with one mission: end unsheltered homelessness for veterans, families with children, unaccompanied youth, and seniors by 2025. I’ll immediately prioritize expanding managed shelters, improving access to mental health and addiction services, and getting new street outreach teams on the ground to help people get off the streets, tent by tent. On Day One, I will issue an executive order to increase the pace and scale of housing production statewide, with a focus on financing housing that’s affordable for middle class families. Oregonians deserve a governor who will roll up her sleeves, sweat the details, and find real solutions to Oregon’s biggest problems. The contrast could not be more clear. Democrats have a plan to expand and protect Social Security. This week, it was announced that Social Security recipients would receive an 8% increase – the largest increase in 40 years. **Jahana wants to build on that and continue to expand Social Security.**
For decades, Social Security has been a secure source of income for millions of Americans – never missing a payment, even during periods of crisis.
**If Republicans take back the House, they have a plan to sunset Social Security.**

Friend: Today, I wanted to reach out and tell you a little bit about myself. My story speaks to exactly why I'm in this fight – and it's important I share that with you.

First, here's a picture of me as a kid with a few of my siblings! (I'm in the bottom-right corner.)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52738904/373203824/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4511-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjVkMDY4Yy04MDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pGa5zUqlwQjYa52LE8ImjgZGxUi7X9gfOhIDShHDyQY=)
I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah, Georgia. I had 11 brothers and sisters – and while my family was short on money, we were long on love and faith. My parents taught us the meaning of hard work and always said we could do _anything_ we put our minds to. Thanks to their support, I became the first in my family to earn a college degree.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52738905/373203825/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4511-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjVkMDY4Yy04MDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pGa5zUqlwQjYa52LE8ImjgZGxUi7X9gfOhIDShHDyQY=)
From there, I followed in the footsteps of my mom and dad – both preachers – and eventually worked my way up to become the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, the spiritual home of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52738906/373203853/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4511-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjVkMDY4Yy04MDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pGa5zUqlwQjYa52LE8ImjgZGxUi7X9gfOhIDShHDyQY=)
But I've always believed my impact doesn't stop at the church doors. That's just where it begins. That's why I ran for the U.S. Senate in the first place. Last year, with unprecedented grassroots support from folks like you, we made _history_. Now, I'm humbled to serve as Georgia's first Black senator and work hard to make sure every child can achieve their American dream – just like I did.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52738907/373203854/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4511-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjVkMDY4Yy04MDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pGa5zUqlwQjYa52LE8ImjgZGxUi7X9gfOhIDShHDyQY=)
Here's the thing, friend: Keeping up this fight won't be easy. _NPR_ is calling me the most vulnerable Senate Democrat up for reelection – and experts confirm this race could decide Senate control.

**So the only way I can protect my seat and continue being a voice for Georgians is with your help.****That's why I'm personally asking:****[Will you chip in $5 or more today, before the mid-month deadline, to help us win in Georgia, defend the Senate, and secure a brighter future for our country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52738908/373203855/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4511-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjVkMDY4Yy04MDRkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pGa5zUqlwQjYa52LE8ImjgZGxUi7X9gfOhIDShHDyQY=)**

name: Charles Booker
subject: Insulin should be free
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Last night, during the Georgia Senate debate between Raphael Warnock and
Herschel Walker, the Republican nominee made a ridiculous statement
castigating Georgians to eat healthier instead of agreeing with Warnock
that insulin prices should be capped or lowered.

As someone with Type 1 diabetes, I want to make something perfectly clear
to Herschel Walker, Rand Paul, and every jackass politician who thinks
diabetics are all lazy people with bad diets: We need insulin to live.

A change in diet wouldn’t make my disease go away. And we shouldn’t die
because we can’t afford our medicine.

Put simply, insulin should be free.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18755?t=1001&akid=2607%2E346206%2E-KXLQ1 ]Please pitch in $20 or more to help my campaign DEFEAT Rand Paul on
November 8th. I can’t do this without you.

My name is Charles Booker. I’m on a mission to defeat Rand Paul and
restore leadership to the Senate and representation for Kentucky, from the
Hood to the Holler.

Thanks,

Charles Booker

body:
#
Peter —
When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue.
I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested.
You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million.
Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done.
And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied.
So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat.
I’m so grateful for everyone who has pitched in their time and talent already.
