clean_body: Peter — When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue. I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested. You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million. Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done. And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied. So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat. I've been an activist my entire life, friend. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the _millions,_ to usher in great progress for this nation.
But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election.
If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip _this_ seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. BREAKING... recent developments have shaken up the race for Ohio's 9th Congressional District, where environmental champion Rep. Marcy Kaptur is in a tough race against Trump-endorsed MAGA extremist J.R. Majewski.

Ohio Republicans redrew Rep. Kaptur's district in hopes of unseating her as the longest-serving woman in House history. But their candidate has thrown that plan into jeopardy following a series of bizarre lies about his record of military service.

J.R. Majewski claimed he'd been deployed to Afghanistan. That was a lie. He claimed he'd earned a demotion after a fight in his Air Force dorm. In fact, he'd been caught driving while intoxicated.

Earlier this summer, Majewski was favored to win the race. Now -- even in this heavily gerrymandered district -- we have _an incredible shot_ at reelecting Rep. Kaptur. Members of Congress like her are the reason we were able to win passage of historic climate legislation this year. **We can 't let environmental champions lose their seats this November -- we need your help to turn out pro-environment voters in key races.**

Bottom line -- we need your help. [Our Get-Out-The-Vote program needs to go even bigger in Ohio, Michigan, Pennsylvania and other swing states and districts to help pro-environment candidates win. If everyone reading this right now pitched in -- even just $5 -- we'd blow through that goal in minutes. Every contribution is being triple matched right now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

We have a real chance at turning out enough voters to win, Peter. In districts like Ohio's 9th and others, we can re-elect proven environmental champions to Congress ... or we can risk losing to extremist candidates who will tear down _all_ of the big environmental progress we've worked so hard to achieve. **In races this close, the environmental movement can make the difference.**

Yet without more resources, expanding our campaign in Ohio would mean scaling back our investments in other critical House and Senate races. Right now, we're also in the middle of major efforts to help turn out voters in places like Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.

And we can't go after extremists like Majewski if it'd mean losing a shot at defeating candidates like Sen. Ron Johnson in Wisconsin or Herschel Walker in Georgia.

**We 're asking for your help -- and it needs to be now.** Opportunities like these could seriously swing this election, but only if voters hear from us before they cast their ballots. We need to move quickly if we want to have an impact.

[Your support will make an immediate impact if you give to LCV Victory Fund today. Even $5 makes a difference. Donate now and your contribution will be tripled >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

We can do this -- we just have to do it together. And there is no time to waste.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Where I know we could be doing better, Derek
body:
Dear Derek,
I feel really good about where we are in this campaign.
At 100,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election.
Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters — especially young voters — with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers.
And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, six major mass shootings on his watch, or the outright banning of reproductive health care freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for change.
The polls are starting to show it as well. A new one has us within just four points — and within the margin of error — of Abbott.
The only place where I know we could be doing better is fundraising.
While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win.
As we continue organizing everywhere, I hope that you’ll consider splitting a donation between our campaign and CommonGood. I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have, the progress we’re making and this extraordinary chance before us to win. body:
Logo

Peter,

I hope you have all have not forgotten what happened with Mayra Flores's upset win in Texas's 34th District this summer. Her win just proved what I have been saying about my race this entire time. Mayra’s district is 84% Hispanic - mine is 85%. Mayra’s district went OVERWHELMINGLY for Hillary Clinton in 2016... as did mine.

Mayra’s district went overwhelmingly for Joe Biden in 2020... just like mine. After eighteen months of an open border, ridiculously high gas prices, and the general destruction of our American way of life Mayra just OVERWHELMINGLY WON THE DISTRICT!

So many people been telling me it is impossible to win a Hispanic district in South Texas — but they have now been proven wrong. What you need to win is a strong, steadfast candidate who can relate to the voters in Spanish and English - just like Mayra did in her district, I will do that in my district. And we’re winning in nearly every metric that matters.

Do I need to remind you that Joe Biden’s Hispanic approval rating is a mere 24% and dropping every single day? We have a window of opportunity to flip Hispanic districts like we have never seen in our lifetimes... especially after the Dobbs ruling. There is no group more pro-life in this nation than Hispanics!
HELP THE GOP WIN THE HISPANIC VOTE! (https://secure.winred.com/irene-armendariz-jackson-for-congress/donate-copy-d24359ed2cea3b72)

I’m Irene, a wife to a Border Patrol Agent and Veteran, a mother to 3 beautiful daughters, a grandmother to 4 precious grandchildren, a small business owner, and a first-generation American to Mexican immigrants; naturalized citizens, and a firm believer in the American dream.

I grew up in El Paso and am proud to call this incredible community home. Now, I need your help to reclaim this great place that I call home. I’m up against a Democrat candidate that has become lost to the radical Left. She votes with AOC almost 100% of the time and makes Pelosi’s positions look fairly moderate. Her name is Veronica Escobar - and the only reason she’s not part of the Squad is because the Squad doesn’t want her in their club. But she votes with them every single chance she gets.

I want to ensure that we have the chance to flip this district just like Mayra flipped hers. We have the chance to get all five seats that we need to take back the House right here in Southern Texas. I’m going to need to start building a serious war chest to win this race —we’ve been doing well on fundraising but we need to do much better to guarantee victory. I’ll be very fast –

Peter,
Our calendar has been jam-packed – here are a few things that we’ve been up to on the campaign trail!
Last Wednesday, Wade celebrated Pre-K Week here in Georgia at Henderson E. Formey School’s Early Learning Center! When it was still East Broad Elementary, Wade would often volunteer, and his wife Susan taught there for 5 years. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/reading_edit.jpg]
Throughout this campaign, Wade has had the honor of meeting various elected officials and candidates. Last Thursday, Wade shared the stage with Sen. Warnock throughout Chatham and Liberty Counties! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-10-12-114037_010_edit.gif]
On Tuesday we traveled a couple of hours south to Kingsland for a meet and greet! (P.S. – Camden County, have you seen our billboard? 👀) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/FevTOeWXoAcqbUo_edit.jpg]
On Wednesday, Women for Wade and Bryan County Dems hosted an event at Love’s Seafood & Steaks – a beautiful evening with delicious food & drinks. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/IMG_2777_edit.jpg]
Yesterday, we hosted Wade on Wheels and traveled with folks around Savannah on a variety of wheeled means. We were thankful to be joined by Savannah Aldermen Nick Palumbo and Detric Leggett! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/IMG_2981_edit.jpg]
We started Saturday evening at Dinner Under The Stars in support of Morning Star Children & Family Services in Glynn County and then headed to Fort Stewart in Liberty County for the NAACP Freedom Banquet! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-10-16-195144_008.gif]
We’ve got another busy week ahead (including two debates!) – stay tuned for more updates soon.
Onwards,
The Wade Brigade

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

25 hours.

Derek, we only
have 25 hours left until Stacey takes the stage to debate Brian Kemp for
the first time in 4 years.

And we only have 25 hours until the voters can cast their first in-person
ballots.

With so much on the line, we must connect with as many voters as we can
across our state to share Stacey’s message of education, housing,
healthcare and a good living.

That’s why we launched our Debate Night Fund,
Derek: to go into the final hours
of this campaign with all cylinders firing. We’ve set an ambitious goal to
raise $500,000 by tomorrow night — but we haven’t reached it yet.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=Sa_em_221016_B4_HQ26Hours_S1_T1_TA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=13453%2E1862389%2ENBod-n ]There’s much more work to do if we’re going to spread Stacey Yvonne
Abrams’ message and get as many of our supporters as possible to early
voting locations. Will you chip in $5 now to help us
mobilize voters casting their ballots for Stacey?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=Sa_em_221016_B4_HQ26Hours_S1_T1_TA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13453%2E1862389%2ENBod-n ]DONATE

Hitting our goal by tomorrow night will demonstrate our team’s strength
and energy to everyone. But if we fall short, it will signal to Brian Kemp
and everyone else that our momentum is slowing down.

That is why we’re working hard across the state to earn every vote in this
election and mobilize as many Georgians as possible to vote during the
first week of early voting.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=Sa_em_221016_B4_HQ26Hours_S1_T1_TA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=13453%2E1862389%2ENBod-n ]Will you help fill our Debate Night Fund with a $5
investment now — before Stacey takes the stage in just 25 hours? If
everyone reading this — including you — chips in now we’ll hit our goal in
no time.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=Sa_em_221016_B4_HQ26Hours_S1_T1_TA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=13453%2E1862389%2ENBod-n ]DONATE

can’t do this without you. Thank you.

Team Abrams

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: Our 3-part plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Let’s get into it!
#
Derek,
There are exactly 23 days left to elect John, defeat Dr. Oz, and defend + expand our Senate majority.
We’re going to tell you how we see our path to win over these next 23 days — but first, if you’re ready to do your part, **[will you chip in your first $5 donation right now to flip PA’s Senate seat blue before our final pre-election FEC deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)**
**[Yes, I'll chip in now!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)**
OK, let’s get into it! 💪
**FIRST** , we’ve gotta fight back against these nasty right-wing attacks. With GOP super PACs, Fox News, and Dr. Oz slinging mud nonstop at John, our immediate priority is to get more ads on the air + ensure PA voters know the TRUTH.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)
**THEN** , we’ve gotta keep John on the road. Our motto is Every County, Every Vote — no part of Pennsylvania is too small, rural, or “red” for John. At the end of the day, John’s running for this seat to fight like hell for ALL working families.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)
**IN THE FINAL DAYS** , it’s GOTV, GOTV, GOTV all day long. We’ll be contacting every single PA voter we can to make sure they get to the polls to support John + flip this seat blue.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)
**We have so much left to do before November 8, and we can’t afford to fall short.[Please, Derek, if you want John Fetterman in the U.S. Senate, chip in anything you can right now to fund our ads, travel, and GOTV before our FEC deadline in three days. This is our path to win!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221016-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221016-7757&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)**
Let’s do this,
Team Fetterman HQ 💛

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221016-7757-footer&t=1&refcode2=7757_434096_oV2lQE&akid=7757%2E434096%2EoV2lQE)**

[1]Charles Booker

Last week, the January 6th select Committee held its final hearing. As I
watched, I was horrified by the newly-released footage from the day's
events. And I was reminded of Donald Trump’s authoritarian attempt to hold
onto power despite losing the election.

And how did my opponent Rand Paul respond to Trump’s Big Lie? He spread
it. And when a bipartisan group of Senators voted to impeach Trump, Paul
refused.

When the Jan. 6 Committee was formed a few months later, Rand Paul wanted
no hearings or accountability. He doesn’t support the Committee’s work.

Rand Paul does not believe in democracy. So he must be removed from
office. I’m running for Senate to hold him accountable at the ballot box.
